[color=#00ff00][size=6][u]Better Break Geodes[/u][/size][/color][/i][/b][/font][/center]


[font=Georgia][b][i][color=#ff00ff][size=5]It looked like Clint was in a trance. The geodes were being broken, but he didn't even move![/size][/color][/i][/b][/font]


[font=Georgia][size=4]This mod essentially does three things: It reduces or eliminates the animation for breaking geodes, allows you to break multiple geodes at the same time, and lets you either hold down the click or set it to automatic.[/size][/font]

[size=4][font=Georgia][b]Bulk:[/b][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/7hzfhDWc/Geode1.gif[/img][/font][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Georgia]Press Left Shift + Click to break multiple geodes according to the number configured in GMCM.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Georgia]Press Left Ctrl + Click to break the entire stack at once.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][font=Georgia][b]Automatic[/b][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/RhtNh9Dy/Geode2.gif[/img][/font][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Georgia]Tap the anvil once and watch as the geodes shatter one by one.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][font=Georgia][b]Hold[/b][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/d3CL3vxg/Geode3.gif[/img][/font][/size]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Hold down the mouse button and watch those geodes break; the interval between each one is configurable in GMCM.[/size][/font][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][font=Georgia][color=#ff0000][b]Mobile restrictions:[/b][/color] Due to compatibility issues, only the “Hold” option will be available, along with the animation speed and the speed for breaking geodes. The rest would cause the game to crash, literally shutting down without warning.[/font][/size]


[font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=5][b][i]That's all there is to it. You'll need GMCM to configure the mod however you like so you can find the settings that best suit your needs. [/i][/b][/size][/color][/font]


[b][font=Georgia][i][u][color=#ff0000][size=5]Translations[/size][/color][/u][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; you don't need to ask my permission.[/size]
[size=4]You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods. [color=#00ffff](Recommended)[/color][/size]
[size=4]If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/size]
